subject: Private Edge deployment: feasibility & resourcing questions
messages:
From: Katie Brown <katie@edgeworks.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgeworks.io
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Private Edge deployment: initial feasibility & timeline questions

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this — EdgeWorks is evaluating a pilot to run Redwood Private at our retail edge sites (small on-prem racks at ~25 stores) and we need to understand feasibility and rough runway. We're at an early stage but want to surface key constraints now so we don't hit blockers later.

High-level context:
- Pilot: 25 stores, each with a single 4U rack, low-latency inference for checkout/assistant features.
- Data residency: customer data never leaves store; logs allowed to aggregate to a central EU/US region.
- Expected traffic: bursts up to 80 rps aggregate (peaks), mostly short-chat/completion calls.

Questions we hope Redwood can cover quickly:
1) Architecture patterns you recommend for fully on-prem at the edge vs a hybrid routing approach.
2) Minimum hardware (GPU/CPU/storage) for a reliable pilot.
3) Ops/resourcing assumptions on Redwood side for support and on-call.
4) Any compliance or network requirements we should plan for (firewall, ports, certs).

I'm attaching our network requirements doc (Edge-Network-Requirements-v2.pdf) for reference.

We'd like to schedule a 60-minute working session this week if possible — Tue or Wed mornings PT preferred. Also copying our procurement address for contract/PO logistics.

Best,
Katie Brown
Head of Platform
EdgeWorks

Attachment: Edge-Network-Requirements-v2.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Katie Brown <katie@edgeworks.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, procurement@edgeworks.io
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Edge deployment: initial feasibility & timeline questions

Katie — thanks, appreciate the context and the doc. Happy to run a working session. I'm available Tue 9/14 10:00-12:00 PT; does that work?

Looping in Marissa (product) and Karthik (infra) to scope the technical/ops asks. Naomi and Grace from our Ops/GTM teams are cc'd for staffing and procurement coordination.

Quick notes / info we typically need up-front:
- QPS profile by store (avg vs peak) and preferred per-call latency SLOs.
- Whether stores are on reliable broadband vs cellular-only fallback.
- Any corporate proxy/firewall constraints (e.g., egress blocked).
- Data classification for logs and telemetry (PII? PHI?).

Proposed agenda for the working session (60m):
- 10m: goals & success criteria for pilot
- 15m: network and security constraints (from your doc)
- 20m: infra topology options (on-prem host vs hybrid control plane)
- 10m: resourcing / timeline and next steps
- 5m: outstanding procurement items

Marissa / Karthik — can you prepare:
- A short slide with two feasible topologies (edge-only, hybrid-cloud control plane) and the trade-offs.
- A back-of-envelope HW profile for the pilot (per-store) and an ops-headcount estimate to support 25 stores.

Katie — if Tue 10:00 PT works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (runbook template and checklist).

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Principal Partner Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Katie Brown <katie@edgeworks.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Edge deployment: initial feasibility & timeline questions

Thanks Logan — filing some initial product/ops questions so we can make the working session focused.

Referring to points in Katie's doc:
- Data flow: the "never leaves store" requirement implies we need a fully air-gapped model at the edge or strict TLS-only egress for control plane telemetry. If fully air-gapped, we need to qualify exception paths for model updates and telemetry.
- Model updates cadence: how often will EdgeWorks expect model refreshes? Weekly/bi-weekly? Over-the-air for security patches?
- Monitoring: what level of telemetry is acceptable to be shipped off-site vs retained on-device?

Items I'm asking teams to bring to the session:
- Karthik: two topology diagrams (edge-only with local model bundle + hybrid with central routing), rough per-store HW minimums, and a short list of networking ports/protocols required.
- Naomi: GTM/ops impact — support SLA expectations, training, and runbook handover.
- Grace: commercial implications — pricing model for small-footprint per-store seats and any minimum commit.

Action items before the session:
- Karthik to post a preliminary capacity estimate in the Drive and call out any hard blockers (GPU availability, quantization constraints).
- Naomi to draft a one-page support play (on-call rotations, escalation path).
- Logan to circulate tech checklist (I'll attach our redwood_private_requirements_checklist.xlsx).

Linking a short pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-edgeworks-requirements

We should also flag an exception process if EdgeWorks requires no external connectivity at all — that will add time and likely an extra security review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP Product — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, Katie Brown <katie@edgeworks.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Edge deployment: initial feasibility & timeline questions

Following up with a back-of-envelope capacity + resourcing note ahead of the working session. This is very preliminary — we'll refine after the call but want to surface obvious constraints.

Prelim HW profile (per store, pilot = 25 stores):
- 1x small GPU server (e.g., 1x A10 or equivalent), 2x CPU socket equivalent, 256GB NVMe (for KV cache + logs), 128GB RAM. If using quantized LLMs we can fit smaller GPUs (e.g., T4-class) but that increases latency.
- Network: 1 Gbps WAN recommended. Latency to local devices sub-10ms target.

Ops/resourcing (Redwood-side estimate for pilot support):
- Dedicated onboarding PM (0.5 FTE for 6 weeks)
- Infra/SRE: 2 FTEs (pilot duration) for runbook creation, automation, and incident on-call coverage
- Platform engineer (part-time, ~0.3 FTE) for packaging model bundles and release automation

Timeline (best-case):
- Pilot prep and config: 3-4 weeks (if hybrid control plane allowed)
- Fully air-gapped pilot (exception needed): ~8-12 weeks due to security approvals and manual update flow

Ballpark cost delta vs hosted: pilot incremental engineering + on-site HW (~$18k-$28k per site HW depending on GPU choice) + 0.5-1.0 FTE in ops for the first 3 months. Exact numbers depend on model size, QPS, and telemetry requirements; we'll refine after the call.

Notes / hard blockers to flag:
- If EdgeWorks requires no connectivity, we must validate model update flow (signed bundles via USB or secure courier) and certify that telemetry is fully disabled. This will trigger an exceptions review with Security and could delay start.
- GPU procurement lead times are material — if you need A100-class, expect 12+ week lead time. Recommend piloting on quantized models that run on smaller GPUs for faster turnaround.

Attaching a quick CSV with the rough numbers: prelim-capacity-estimate.csv
HubSpot deal id: HS-23456

I'll bring a short deck with two topology diagrams to Tue's working session.

— Karthik
